description: Canonical backlog for expensive runner, browser-matrix, and real-target certification work that is discovered during implementation and drained against the settled final head.

entries.title: WorkIntel CI exact-head release certification
entries.scope: Run the canonical WorkIntel CI workflow on the exact final PR head, including source/tests/build, migrations/seeds, PHPUnit, production doctors, browser/accessibility coverage, MySQL, routes, scheduler, and any required governance status wired into that workflow.
entries.defer_reason: This is the consolidated remote release workflow. Re-running the complete matrix after every intermediate implementation commit wastes runner capacity and can certify heads that will immediately become stale.
acceptance: The required WorkIntel CI status is green for the exact settled final head SHA.
No required workflow job, release doctor, database lane, browser lane, governance gate, route check, or scheduler check is skipped, bypassed, faked, or weakened.
Run URL or run identifier is recorded in verification.evidence.

entries.title: Windows cross-browser release certification
entries.scope: Run the WorkIntel Windows Certification workflow on the exact final PR head with the workflow-required installed Chrome, Microsoft Edge, and Firefox browser/accessibility gates.
entries.defer_reason: The Windows and real-system-browser matrix is intentionally the expensive final release lane and should certify a settled head rather than intermediate UI commits.
acceptance: Windows Certification is green for the exact settled final head SHA.
Chrome, Microsoft Edge, and Firefox requirements are actually satisfied by the workflow; missing system browsers are not silently substituted.
Responsive and accessibility browser gates required by the workflow pass without coverage reduction.
Run URL or run identifier is recorded in verification.evidence.

entries.title: External WAVE scan when a public release candidate exists
entries.scope: Run the real WebAIM WAVE adapter only when the current scope requires it and a public release candidate plus valid WAVE credentials are available.
entries.defer_reason: Hosted WAVE is an external real-target check that cannot certify localhost or private development URLs and should not be repeatedly invoked while the release candidate is still changing.
acceptance: The scan actually executes against the stated public release-candidate URL.
The result is reported separately from repository-local accessibility evidence.
No WAVE pass claim is made when credentials or a public target are unavailable.
Evidence reference is recorded when the scan is executed.

entries.title: Real-target runtime closure when the approved scope requires it
entries.scope: Capture non-destructive real-target runtime closure evidence when the approved change requires runtime/release-target proof in addition to source CI and browser certification.
entries.defer_reason: Runtime closure is a separate, potentially environment-sensitive evidence class and should be run once the candidate head and target environment are stable.
acceptance: The runtime closure command succeeds on the approved target for the exact candidate head.
The timestamped diagnostic evidence is retained with secrets reviewed/redacted according to repository policy.
Evidence reference is recorded when runtime proof is required by scope.
depends_on: Approved scope explicitly requires real-target/runtime evidence

entries.title: Issue #70 AccessControl SQLite seed stress diagnostics

source.ref: #70 CI: harden intermittent AccessControlSeeder owner-role failure

entries.scope: Run the repeated fresh SQLite seed diagnostic lane for the Issue #70 maintenance work package so any recurrence captures exact workspace owner, demo-user, membership, role, and member-role state without retrying or weakening the owner-role invariant.
entries.defer_reason: The 12-cycle stress lane is a GitHub-hosted runner diagnostic intended to certify the settled maintenance candidate. Running it on every intermediate branch commit would create stale evidence and consume runner capacity without improving local source feedback.
acceptance: The settled Issue #70 candidate either completes 12/12 fresh SQLite seed cycles with owner/coordinator and SQLite integrity/foreign-key invariants intact or fails with retained actionable diagnostics.
Any failed cycle retains both raw Artisan output and a JSON state artifact containing relevant identity, membership, role/pivot, row-count, SQLite sequence, integrity, and foreign-key evidence.
RoleAccessService owner-role fail-closed behavior is not weakened, bypassed, or retried.
A green rerun is not treated as root-cause proof; Issue #70 remains open until the actual nondeterministic cause is captured and a focused regression fix is proven.
Final execution evidence is recorded for the exact candidate head when this maintenance work enters certification.
